event_scope: Australia parent entities and Hellas subsidiary; related 2019-issue reallocation
declared_rationale: Partnership value creation, co-management and renewable pipeline growth; retrospective stewardship classification explicitly covers the two disposals.
rationale_evidence_level: Issuer-stated; no independent causal motive identification
documented_conditions: Australia: foreign-investment and antitrust clearances plus customary conditions. Hellas: antitrust plus customary conditions.
documented_alternatives: Joint-control continuation is explicit. A formal comparison with full sale, retention or other bidders is not documented in inspected sources.
observed_ownership_or_physical_outcome: 50% subsidiary interests transferred and joint control retained; Cohuna vehicles show 50% group holding at year-end. Pool removal is not physical plant retirement.
corporate_capital_allocation_link: Partnership and balance-sheet effects are stated; sale receipts are not traced into the receiving renewable projects.
direct_selected_instrument_link: Explicit: 2023 allocation report attributes EUR 156.86m replacement within the 2019 issue to deconsolidation.
physical_implementation_link: No source-explicit extension from this renewable-pool change to separate coal closures.
window_role: Within 2022–2023 report-vintage interval; transaction dates known but exact allocation-effective dates unknown
unresolved_outcome: Exact reallocation days, precise Kafireas plant-level retained stake, plant operation following pool removal, and receipt-to-capex flows are not established.

event_scope: 13-plant Mexico sale; 12 combined-cycle stations and one wind farm
declared_rationale: Capital recycling toward renewables and US/European opportunities, financial strength and continuing supply to Mexican private customers.
rationale_evidence_level: Issuer-stated; no independent causal motive identification
documented_conditions: Definitive contracts and regulatory approvals. By end-2023 COFECE remained outstanding in the annual transaction note; closing subsequently followed clearance.
documented_alternatives: Age, concession renewal and litigation-stopped assets are disclosed context. Formal retain-versus-sell or bidder alternatives are not documented.
observed_ownership_or_physical_outcome: Ownership exit completed. Buyer-trust PPAs and temporary management services preserve contractual connections; the report specifies planned purchases from four sold plants.
corporate_capital_allocation_link: Capital-recycling intention is explicit; actual sale-receipt redeployment is not traced to a named renewable asset or financing instrument.
direct_selected_instrument_link: Not documented in inspected records: selected February 2019 hybrid remains assigned to East Anglia ONE and Wikinger.
physical_implementation_link: No verified retirement or measured post-sale generation is inferred from disposal or PPAs.
window_role: MoU/agreement in 2022–2023 interval; completed ownership exit in 2023–2024 interval
unresolved_outcome: 8,436 MW announced gas scope versus 8,494 MW annual gas-bridge outflow differs by 58 MW; PPA durations, delivered volumes and services duration are unspecified; 55% means Mexican EBITDA.

documented_conditions: Construction/technical risk assigned to Siemens until handover; performance guarantees and deferred SSE exposure; proceeded without a 2018 auction capacity contract.

actual_implementation_date: 2023-03-15 commercial operation; construction start 2018-08 retrospectively disclosed

physical_implementation_link: New gas plant delivered; hydrogen blending still under exploration in completion source. Keadby 3 CCS is a different project.
window_role: Prior context for matched 31 March 2023–31 March 2024 interval; commissioning predates opening cutoff
unresolved_outcome: 2022 commissioning forecast versus March 2023 realization is observed without assigning a quantified delay cause or day-level lateness; bond additionality unidentified.
